grid.note: Coordinates are on the screen's normalised grid; each screen defines its own rows/columns (the shipped screens use 110 rows x 200 columns, ~16:9). z-order is the instrument list order: later entries paint on top.

layout_fields.row: Grid row of the top-left corner (0-based).
layout_fields.column: Grid column of the top-left corner (0-based).
layout_fields.span: {rows, columns}: how many grid cells the instrument occupies.
layout_fields.disabled: Feature-flag name resolved via the preferences `enabled:` section (string), or a literal bool to hide the instrument.

back_screen.label: Back screen
back_screen.help: screen the Back button returns to

edge_fade.label: Fade tape edges
edge_fade.help: alpha-fade the top and bottom of the scrolling scale into the background (SVS shows through)

show_tas.label: Show TAS box
show_tas.help: show the true-airspeed readout box (from TAS)

show_trend.label: Show trend arrow
show_trend.help: show the acceleration trend vector along the tape

trend_lookahead.label: Trend look-ahead (s)
trend_lookahead.help: seconds ahead the trend vector projects current accel

ias_bug.label: IASSEL bug and box
ias_bug.help: the IASSEL bug and a target box at the top of the tape, shown while the autopilot reports IAS active or armed

ias_bug_color.label: IASSEL bug color
ias_bug_color.help: colour of the IASSEL bug and the target box value

touch_edit.label: Touch to set IASSEL
touch_edit.help: touch the IASSEL box, then turn the knob to set the autopilot's target airspeed: inner ring 1 kt, outer ring 10 kt, push syncs to the current airspeed. Only while the box is shown (IAS active or armed)

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

edge_fade.label: Fade tape edges
edge_fade.help: alpha-fade the top and bottom of the scrolling scale into the background (SVS shows through)

dbkey.label: FIX key
dbkey.help: FIX key driving the tape (default ALT)

maxalt.label: Max altitude
maxalt.help: top of the tape's altitude range (ft)

minorDiv.label: Minor division
minorDiv.help: altitude between the small tape ticks (ft)

total_decimals.label: Total digits
total_decimals.help: number of digits in the altitude readout

font_mask.label: Font mask
font_mask.help: widest string the readout reserves space for (sizing)

round_to.label: Round readout to
round_to.help: round the readout to this increment (0 = none)

numeric_box.label: Show numeric box
numeric_box.help: show the boxed numeric altitude over the tape

font_scale.label: Scale-number font scale
font_scale.help: multiplier on the tape scale-number font size

show_baro.label: Baro setting box
show_baro.help: touch-selectable altimeter setting box at the bottom of the tape (on for an ALT tape unless the screen has its own BARO readout; off for a VS tape)

altsel_box.label: Selected-altitude box
altsel_box.help: touch-settable ALTSEL box at the top of the tape (on for an ALT tape, off for a VS tape)

alt_bug_enabled.label: Altitude bug
alt_bug_enabled.help: draw the selected-altitude bug on the scale (follows the box unless set)

alt_bug_color.label: Altitude bug color
alt_bug_color.help: colour of the selected-altitude box text and bug

alt_bug_alert_color.label: Altitude alert color
alt_bug_alert_color.help: box text and bug colour while fix-gateway flags an altitude deviation (the key's annunciate flag)

alt_bug_dbkey.label: Selected-altitude key
alt_bug_dbkey.help: FIX key holding the selected altitude (default ALTSEL)

altsel_capture_color.label: Altitude capture color
altsel_capture_color.help: selected-altitude box border while the autopilot captures it (APALTCAP)

vs_bug.label: VSSEL bug
vs_bug.help: on a VS tape, the VSSEL bug while the autopilot reports VS active (on for a VS tape, off for an ALT tape)

vs_bug_dbkey.label: Selected-VS key
vs_bug_dbkey.help: FIX key holding the selected vertical speed (default VSSEL)

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

maxvs.label: Range (ft/min)
maxvs.help: full scale, plus and minus; pick to suit the airplane's climb/descent performance (AC 23.1311-1C 8.11)

minorDiv.label: Tick interval (ft/min)
minorDiv.help: minor tick mark every N ft/min

numberedDiv.label: Numbered interval (ft/min)
numberedDiv.help: numbered graduation every N ft/min (labels print in hundreds: 2400 ft/min prints as 24)

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.help: list of lamps: label, key, and at most one of when (a Button-grammar condition), flag (annunciate, old, bad, fail) or enum (value -> text); plus on_text, off_text, level and flash_on_change seconds. Red/amber levels only with flag: annunciate

cols.label: Columns
cols.help: columns of tiles; 0 = as many as the tiles need

border_width.label: Tile outline (px)
border_width.help: tile outline thickness; doubled while a change flashes

ap_position.label: AP/YD position
ap_position.help: left: AP YD | lateral | vertical; center: lateral | AP YD | vertical, the control head's order

mode_flash_s.label: Mode change flash (s)
mode_flash_s.help: how long a new active mode is boxed and flashes

touch_ack.label: Tap acknowledges disconnect
touch_ack.help: a tap on the strip sends APCMD DISC while a disconnect alert (APDISC) is shown and the autopilot is disengaged

active_color.label: Active mode colour
active_color.help: active modes and AP/YD engaged (AC 25-11B Table 5-1: engaged modes green)

warning_color.label: Disconnect warning colour
warning_color.help: the flashing AP of a disconnect alert (APDISC)

dbkey.label: FIX key
dbkey.help: FIX-database key whose value this gauge displays

name.label: Name
name.help: label drawn on the gauge (e.g. OIL P, CHT)

decimal_places.label: Decimal places
decimal_places.help: digits after the decimal point in the readout

show_units.label: Show units
show_units.help: append the FIX key's engineering units to the readout

segments.label: Segments
segments.help: 0 = solid band; >0 draws a segmented (LED-style) band

name_location.label: Name location
name_location.help: where the name label sits relative to the gauge

tank.label: Tank
tank.help: Bind to a tank from the aircraft page

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

encoder_set_key.label: Knob writes key
encoder_set_key.help: FIX key the knob writes; blank = the key this gauge displays

encoder_coarse_multiplier.label: Outer ring step factor
encoder_coarse_multiplier.help: the outer ring steps the value by knob step x this

encoder_set_real_time.label: Write while turning
encoder_set_real_time.help: send each step to the FIX key as the knob turns; a timeout before push still reverts it. Ignored with a digit mask

touch_edit.label: Touch to edit
touch_edit.help: touch the gauge to give it the knob; it then marks focus with a ring and edit icon

encoder_num_mask.label: Digit mask
encoder_num_mask.help: set the value one digit at a time, e.g. 000.000 for a radio frequency; push moves to the next digit. Blank = step the whole value

encoder_num_mask_blank_character.label: Digit mask blank
encoder_num_mask_blank_character.help: character drawn for the digits not yet set

encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.label: Digits follow knob step
encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.help: digit entry offers only digits that give a multiple of the knob step within the key's range

encoder_num_require_confirm.label: Confirm after last digit
encoder_num_require_confirm.help: after the last digit the value flashes and one more push saves it

encoder_num_8khz_channels.label: 8.33 kHz channels
encoder_num_8khz_channels.help: digit entry shows 8.33 kHz channel numbers; use with a knob step of 0.008333333333

encoder_num_blink_time_on.label: Digit blink on (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_on.help: how long the digit being set shows in each blink

encoder_num_blink_time_off.label: Digit blink off (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_off.help: how long the digit being set is hidden in each blink

aircraft_symbol.label: Aircraft symbol
aircraft_symbol.help: classic split-wing bars + dot; garmin G3X-style two-tone bat wing + horizon barbs; brackets GRT-style L-brackets; none hides the symbol (SVS-as-background) (g1000/gi275 remain accepted in YAML for back-compat)

symbol_color.label: Symbol colour
symbol_color.help: colour of the fixed aircraft reference symbol

symbol_scale.label: Symbol scale
symbol_scale.help: multiplies the reference symbol size -- wingspan and proportions together (1 = standard)

minorDiv.label: Minor division (deg)
minorDiv.help: pitch interval between the smallest ladder ticks

majorDiv.label: Major division (deg)
majorDiv.help: pitch interval between the longer ladder ticks

numberedDiv.label: Numbered division (deg)
numberedDiv.help: pitch interval at which ladder lines get a number

visiblePitchAngle.label: Pitch label range (deg)
visiblePitchAngle.help: ladder marks fade out beyond this from current pitch

bankOpacity.label: Bank display opacity
bankOpacity.help: bank scale, roll pointer, standard-rate diamonds and slip/skid ball together (0 = hidden, 1 = solid)

horizonOpacity.label: Horizon line opacity
horizonOpacity.help: the white zero-pitch reference line (0 = hidden, 1 = solid)

tick_autoscale.label: Auto-scale tick widths to font
tick_autoscale.help: off = use the explicit tick-width / bank-size pixels below

minorDivWidth.label: Minor tick width (px)
minorDivWidth.help: length of the minor pitch ticks (auto-scale off)

majorDivWidth.label: Major tick width (px)
majorDivWidth.help: length of the major pitch ticks (auto-scale off)

numberedDivWidth.label: Numbered tick width (px)
numberedDivWidth.help: length of the numbered pitch ticks (auto-scale off)

drawBankMarkers.label: Standard-rate bank markers
drawBankMarkers.help: show the bank-angle tick arc across the top

bankAngleMaximum.label: Max indicated bank (deg)
bankAngleMaximum.help: largest bank angle marked on the bank arc

excessiveBankDeg.label: Excessive-bank caution (deg)
excessiveBankDeg.help: the bank scale and pointer turn amber past this bank; set it above the steepest turn this aircraft is flown in on purpose (60 clears the 45 and 50 deg steep turns)

bankBugTolerance.label: Bank bug tolerance (+/- deg)
bankBugTolerance.help: half-width of the cyan band around the target-bank bug (BANKBUG); the ACS steep turns are flown to +/-5

touch_edit.label: Touch to set bank bug
touch_edit.help: touch the bank scale, then turn the knob to set the target-bank bug (BANKBUG) in 5 deg steps, from off up to 60 or the excessive-bank caution if lower; push or the timeout ends the edit

bankMarkSize.label: Bank tick size (px)
bankMarkSize.help: length of the bank-arc ticks (auto-scale off)

bank_position.label: Bank scale position (%)
bank_position.help: vertical position of the bank-arc centre, percent up from the bottom (50 = centred, the classic look); the whole cluster incl. pointer and slip ball moves with it

bank_radius.label: Bank scale radius (% height)
bank_radius.help: radius of the bank arc as a percent of widget height (33.3 = the classic height/3); an explicit bankAngleRadius px in YAML overrides it

fd_style.label: Flight director style
fd_style.help: single_cue: a magenta command chevron the aircraft symbol flies into; cross_pointer: separate pitch and roll bars; off: no flight director. Drawn only while FDENG is on and FDPITCH/FDROLL are current

pitch_ladder_avoid_bank.label: Ladder stops below bank arc
pitch_ladder_avoid_bank.help: G1000-style declutter: the ladder climbs into the bank arch but stops below the slip/skid ball

horizon_heading_marks.label: Horizon heading marks
horizon_heading_marks.help: tick marks + labels for compass heading along the horizon

horizon_heading_interval.label: Heading tick interval (deg)
horizon_heading_interval.help: degrees of heading between the horizon ticks

horizon_heading_label_interval.label: Heading label interval (deg)
horizon_heading_label_interval.help: degrees of heading between the numeric labels

horizon_heading_tick_length.label: Heading tick length (px)
horizon_heading_tick_length.help: length of the horizon heading ticks (px)

horizon_heading_color.label: Heading mark colour
horizon_heading_color.help: colour of the horizon heading ticks and labels

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

layout.label: Layout
layout.help: full: three columns (lateral, centre, vertical), each with its value boxes over its keys; compact: two rows, the boxes over one row of keys, for small panels and side strips

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.help: comma list of the keys shown, from APR, NAV, HDG, TRK, AP, FD, YD, LVL, IAS, VNAV, VS, ALT; drop YD for an airplane with no yaw damper. TRK is off by default. A key the autopilot cannot fly is greyed, never hidden

touch_edit.label: Touch to edit
touch_edit.help: touch a value box (HDG, VS, IAS, ALT SEL) to give it the knob: inner/outer steps, push to sync

active_color.label: Active colour
active_color.help: indicator bar of an active mode, and the accent on the active vertical mode's box

armed_color.label: Armed colour
armed_color.help: outline of an armed mode's indicator bar

caution_color.label: Caution colour
caution_color.help: a request not taken, and the no-autopilot-data message

level_color.label: LVL colour
level_color.help: the LVL key's own face colour, so it can be found without looking for its label

text_color.label: Text colour
text_color.help: key labels and the autopilot message

muted_color.label: Unavailable colour
muted_color.help: greyed keys and the box labels

target_color.label: Target colour
target_color.help: the selected values in the boxes

bg_color.label: Background
bg_color.help: panel ground behind the keys and boxes

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

type.label: Type
type.help: simple = click; toggle = on/off state; repeat = auto-repeat while held

dbkey.label: FIX key
dbkey.help: backing touchscreen-button key (TSBTN...); the configurator assigns it automatically

transparent.label: Transparent background
transparent.help: draw no fill so what is behind the button shows through

hover_show.label: Show only on hover
hover_show.help: hide the button until the pointer is over it

config.label: Config file (legacy)
config.help: path to an external button YAML; blank = use the fields above

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

advisory_color.label: Advisory colour
advisory_color.help: advisory lines (white, as G3X and SkyView)

background_color.label: Background colour
background_color.help: the fill behind the lines while any is shown

status_path.label: Updater status file
status_path.help: the updater's status.json, read for CATALOG REFUSED

lines.label: Lines
lines.help: message lines the window holds; past that the last line is +k, and a touch on it opens the full list

advisory_color.label: Advisory colour
advisory_color.help: advisory lines (white, as G3X and SkyView)

background_color.label: Background colour
background_color.help: the fill behind the lines while any is shown

status_path.label: Updater status file
status_path.help: the updater's status.json, read for CATALOG REFUSED

checklists.label: Checklists
checklists.help: inline checklist set: a list of checklist objects, each {id, title, category, sections|items} (challenge/response items). Phase 1 authors this by hand; later the configurator builds it per-aircraft

hmi_group.label: HMI group
hmi_group.help: optional name so a Button's 'checklist ...' actions can target this checklist; blank = every checklist on the screen

text_color.label: Item colour
text_color.help: colour of an un-acknowledged item's challenge text

response_color.label: Response colour
response_color.help: colour of the challenge-response value (the right-hand text)

done_color.label: Acknowledged colour
done_color.help: colour of an item once it has been acknowledged

current_color.label: Current-row colour
current_color.help: highlight colour of the current row while the encoder is controlling the checklist

section_color.label: Section colour
section_color.help: colour of section subheaders and the progress line

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

flightplan_dir.label: Flight plan directory
flightplan_dir.help: directory for stored routes/user waypoints/recent list (<dir>/routes/*.json, user_waypoints.json, recent.json); blank disables catalog Store and FastFind's Recent/User tabs

nasr_db_path.label: Airport db path
nasr_db_path.help: NASR airports.sqlite for FastFind/nearest airport lookup (same path as the moving map's nasr_db_path)

navaid_db_path.label: Navaid db path
navaid_db_path.help: navaids.sqlite for FastFind/nearest navaid and fix lookup (same path as the moving map's navaid_db_path)

procedures_db_path.label: Procedures db path
procedures_db_path.help: procedures-conus.pack for SID/STAR/approach lookup (PA5; on the Pi /data/makerplane-data/procedures/current/procedures.sqlite)

plates_path.label: Plates pack path
plates_path.help: FAA d-TPP plates pack, or a directory holding one or more regional plates packs, for the Charts page (PA12). Blank hides the FPL page's CHARTS key

hold_speed_kt.label: Hold speed (kt)
hold_speed_kt.help: speed a hold coded in minutes is turned into a distance at when the PROC page loads it (one minute at 90 kt = 1.5 nm); the bus carries no leg time

columns.label: Columns
columns.help: comma-separated FPL page data columns, in order; choices DTK, DIS, CUM, ETE, ETA

keypad.label: On-screen keypad
keypad.help: show the gloved-finger on-screen keypad on the Entry/Direct To Waypoint pages and any text/lat-lon prompt

keyboard.label: Physical keyboard
keyboard.help: let a physical keyboard drive an open ident-entry surface (Entry page, Direct To page's Waypoint tab, or a text/lat-lon prompt) while it is open

default_page.label: Default page
default_page.help: page shown when the instrument first paints

hmi_group.label: HMI group
hmi_group.help: optional name so 'flightplan page'/'flightplan direct to' HMI actions can target this instrument; blank = every flight_plan instrument on the screen

active_color.label: Active leg colour
active_color.help: colour of the active (TO) leg's row

future_color.label: Future leg colour
future_color.help: colour of upcoming (not yet flown) legs

row_height_mm.label: List row height (mm)
row_height_mm.help: physical height of one flight-plan row on the glass. Geometry, not text size: it sets the row pitch, the type icon and the row font. A taller pane shows MORE legs at this height rather than fewer, larger ones. Needs screenDiagonalInches to be correct for the device.

encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

dbkey.help: FIX-database key whose value this gauge displays

segments.help: 0 = solid bar; >0 draws a segmented (LED-style) bar

tank.help: Bind to a tank from the aircraft page

encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

encoder_set_key.help: FIX key the knob writes; blank = the key this gauge displays

encoder_coarse_multiplier.help: the outer ring steps the value by knob step x this

encoder_set_real_time.help: send each step to the FIX key as the knob turns; a timeout before push still reverts it. Ignored with a digit mask

touch_edit.help: touch the gauge to give it the knob; it then marks focus with a ring and edit icon

encoder_num_mask.help: set the value one digit at a time, e.g. 000.000 for a radio frequency; push moves to the next digit. Blank = step the whole value

encoder_num_mask_blank_character.label: Digit mask blank
encoder_num_mask_blank_character.help: character drawn for the digits not yet set

encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.label: Digits follow knob step
encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.help: digit entry offers only digits that give a multiple of the knob step within the key's range

encoder_num_require_confirm.label: Confirm after last digit
encoder_num_require_confirm.help: after the last digit the value flashes and one more push saves it

encoder_num_8khz_channels.label: 8.33 kHz channels
encoder_num_8khz_channels.help: digit entry shows 8.33 kHz channel numbers; use with a knob step of 0.008333333333

encoder_num_blink_time_on.label: Digit blink on (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_on.help: how long the digit being set shows in each blink

encoder_num_blink_time_off.label: Digit blink off (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_off.help: how long the digit being set is hidden in each blink

fg_color.label: Foreground
fg_color.help: compass card, ring and text colour

needle_color.label: Needle color
needle_color.help: colour of the CDI/GSI deviation needles

needle_width.label: Needle width
needle_width.help: width of the CDI/GSI deviation needles (px)

source_auto_color.label: Source auto-color
source_auto_color.help: colour the course pointer and CDI by nav source -- magenta for GPS, the VOR/LOC colour for a VOR/LOC source (from NAVSRC)

vloc_color.label: VOR/LOC color
vloc_color.help: course pointer / CDI colour for a VOR or localizer source when source auto-color is on

source_label_enabled.label: Source label
source_label_enabled.help: show the nav-source annunciation (GPS / VLOC1 / VLOC2, or VOR/LOC when NAVTYPE is available) on the rose face

heading_bug_enabled.label: Heading bug
heading_bug_enabled.help: show the cyan heading bug at the selected heading (HEADBUG)

touch_edit.label: Touch to set HDG / CRS
touch_edit.help: touch the HDG or CRS readout, then turn the knob to set it: HDG sets HEADBUG, CRS sets NAV1CRS or NAV2CRS for the selected VLOC source. On GPS, CRS is editable only while the flight plan is in OBS: it sets the OBS course, and push syncs it to the bearing to the waypoint. Inner ring 1 deg, outer ring 10 deg; push syncs HDG to the heading or centres the CDI on CRS

track_indicator_enabled.label: Track diamond
track_indicator_enabled.help: show the magenta GPS ground-track diamond (TRACK), above the speed gate

track_min_speed.label: Track min speed (kt)
track_min_speed.help: hide the track diamond below this groundspeed (kt)

turn_rate_enabled.label: Turn-rate trend
turn_rate_enabled.help: show the magenta turn-rate trend arc from the lubber line to the heading in 6 s at the present rate of turn (ROT), with marks at half and standard rate; hidden when ROT is absent, old, bad or failed

center_symbol.label: Center symbol
center_symbol.help: fixed ownship symbol at the rose centre; 'aircraft' is a silhouette (deliberately not a triangle -- a triangle reads as the TO/FROM / course indicator)

readout_layout.label: Readout layout
readout_layout.help: placement of the integral actual-heading (HEAD), selected-heading (HEADBUG) and course (COURSE) readouts. top_panel = one sectioned panel across the top (outside the rose); corners = selected-heading + course boxes in the top corners; split = heading box above the rose, course/bug in the bottom corners

numeral_scale.label: Numeral size
numeral_scale.help: compass-rose numeral/letter size as a multiple of the base tick font (larger = bigger rose numbers)

depth_rings.label: Depth rings
depth_rings.help: faint concentric rings inside the rose (a light structural cue; real depth comes from the translucent face over the map, so these are off by default)

shadow_enabled.label: Drop shadow
shadow_enabled.help: soft drop shadow on the static elements -- the rose disc and the readout panel -- for a raised, layered look; off by default

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.help: compass presentation. heading_up/north_up/track_up show the full 360 rotating rose (today's look); arc shows an expanded forward ~120 sector (finer resolution on the tracked heading, decluttered of the rear rose)

bearing1_enabled.label: Bearing pointer 1
bearing1_enabled.help: make the single-bar RMI bearing needle (BRG1) available. It points at VOR1 only (BRG1SRC). It starts Off; the BRG tab steps NONE, BRG 1, BRG 2, BOTH, skipping a pointer on the CDI's own source

bearing2_enabled.label: Bearing pointer 2
bearing2_enabled.help: make the double-bar RMI bearing needle (BRG2) available. It points at VOR2 only (BRG2SRC). It starts Off; the BRG tab steps NONE, BRG 1, BRG 2, BOTH, skipping a pointer on the CDI's own source

bearing_color.label: Bearing pointer color
bearing_color.help: colour of both bearing needles, their labels and the BRG tab, whatever the source (source colour is the CDI's)

lists.label: Lists
lists.help: selectable lists -- list of {name, file} entries

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

range_nm.label: Range (NM)
range_nm.help: distance from the ownship anchor to the top edge (to the compass arc in ND mode)

range_key.label: Range control key
range_key.help: optional FIX key that cycles the range at runtime (a button 'change value wrap' / the knob steps the ladder index). Empty = fixed range

range_ladder.label: Range ladder
range_ladder.help: comma list of ranges the range buttons step through

zoom_rail.label: Zoom rail
zoom_rail.help: one-finger range control under the status chip: a vertical rail with one detent per range ladder rung, zoom in at the top. Tap +/- to step one rung, tap the rail to jump to a rung, or drag the thumb. Its touch zone is 20 mm wide and claims every touch inside it

zoom_rail_side.label: Zoom rail side
zoom_rail_side.help: map edge the zoom rail sits on

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.help: track-up rotates the world; north-up rotates ownship

orientation_key.label: Orientation control key
orientation_key.help: optional FIX key that switches orientation at runtime (0=track_up, 1=north_up). Empty = fixed

nd_mode.label: ND mode
nd_mode.help: off = the plain moving map; expanded = Navigation Display EXPANDED MAP: track-up compass arc at the selected range, ownship low (82% down), corner data blocks and a vertical deviation scale from GSI/GSV at the right edge; ctr = CTR MAP: the same with a full compass rose and ownship at the centre. Overrides orientation and ownship position while on

nd_mode_key.label: ND mode control key
nd_mode_key.help: optional FIX key that switches the ND mode at runtime (0=off, 1=expanded, 2=ctr). Empty = fixed

touch_gestures.label: Touch gestures
touch_gestures.help: two-finger pinch=zoom, drag=pan, twist=rotate; mouse wheel zooms and left-drag pans / Shift-drag rotates on desktop; a tap selects (map pointer, Direct To / Insert banner) and a double-tap or the CTR chip re-centres. Off = touch/wheel/drag/tap input ignored

gesture_timeout.label: Gesture auto-revert (s)
gesture_timeout.help: seconds after a two-finger pan/rotate before the view re-locks to ownship and the configured orientation. 0 = stay where left until a double-tap, the CTR chip or an HMI recenter

gesture_frame_rate.label: Gesture frame rate (Hz)
gesture_frame_rate.help: repaint clock rate while a pinch/pan/rotate gesture is live (zoom_by/pan_by/rotate_by mark a frame dirty rather than repainting per event); the normal frame rate applies the rest of the time

pinch_rotate_threshold_deg.label: Pinch rotate threshold (deg)
pinch_rotate_threshold_deg.help: cumulative twist a pinch must reach before it rotates the view; below this a pinch is zoom-only, so a couple of degrees of finger wobble does not nudge orientation (#202)

pinch_pan_threshold_px.label: Pinch pan threshold (px)
pinch_pan_threshold_px.help: centroid movement (screen px) a pinch must reach before it pans the view; below this a pinch is zoom-only (#202)

ownship_position.label: Ownship position (%)
ownship_position.help: ownship anchor, percent up from the bottom (30 = classic look-ahead offset)

symbol_color.label: Ownship colour
symbol_color.help: colour of the top-down ownship symbol

map_style.label: Map style
map_style.help: standard = terrain map; nav_only = terrain relief off (whatever layer_terrain says) and the nav layers repainted for a plain black background. Water follows layer_water, every other layer keeps its own switch

layer_water.label: Layer: water (nav_only)
layer_water.help: under map_style nav_only: lakes and coastline as a flat dark-blue fill, no relief. Under standard, water is part of the terrain image and this switch is not used

layer_range_rings.label: Layer: range rings
layer_range_rings.help: concentric range rings around ownship with distance labels (half and full range unless range ring fractions says otherwise)

range_ring_fractions.label: Range ring fractions
range_ring_fractions.help: comma list of ring radii as fractions of the current range (1 = the top edge). 0.5,1 = half and full range (ND convention); 0.25,0.5,0.75,1 = four even rings. Values outside 0-2 are ignored

range_ring_labels.label: Range ring labels
range_ring_labels.help: print each ring's distance on the ring. The current range stays in the top-left status chip either way

range_ring_label_angle.label: Range ring label position (deg)
range_ring_label_angle.help: where the labels sit on each ring, clockwise from straight up on the screen: 0 = top, 90 = right, 180 = bottom, 270 = left. Move it off a data block

range_ring_width.label: Range ring width (px)
range_ring_width.help: ring line width; 0 = auto (0.2% of the map width, at least 1 px)

range_ring_label_size.label: Range ring label size (px)
range_ring_label_size.help: ring label font pixel size; 0 = auto (2.5% of the map width, at least 8 px)

tile_path.label: Terrain tile path
tile_path.help: GLO-30/SRTM HGT tree (the SVS tile_path; on the Pi /data/makerplane-data/terrain/tiles)

layer_roads.label: Layer: roads
layer_roads.help: roads from the highways pack, LOD by range: interstates when zoomed out (<=80 NM), arterials added as you zoom in (primary <=20 NM, secondary <=5 NM)

highway_db_path.label: Roads db path
highway_db_path.help: highways.sqlite (the SVS highway_db_path; on the Pi /data/makerplane-data/highways/current/highways.sqlite)

road_color.label: Road colour
road_color.help: road line colour (arterial classes draw thinner and slightly transparent)

road_casing_color.label: Road casing colour
road_casing_color.help: outline drawn under a road once zoomed in far enough that it draws at its true width (a few NM and in)

layer_rivers.label: Layer: rivers
layer_rivers.help: rivers/waterways as lines from the rivers pack (#92), LOD by range: major rivers when zoomed out, canals and streams added close in

river_db_path.label: Rivers db path
river_db_path.help: rivers.sqlite (shares the highways schema; on the Pi /data/makerplane-data/rivers/current/rivers.sqlite)

river_color.label: River colour
river_color.help: waterway line colour (smaller waterways draw thinner and slightly transparent)

layer_airports.label: Layer: airports
layer_airports.help: FAA sectional airport symbols with ident labels (declutters by zoom)

nasr_db_path.label: Airport db path
nasr_db_path.help: NASR airports.sqlite (the SVS nasr_db_path; on the Pi /data/makerplane-data/navdata/current/airports.sqlite)

layer_navaids.label: Layer: navaids
layer_navaids.help: VOR/NDB symbols with ident and frequency

layer_fixes.label: Layer: waypoints
layer_fixes.help: named fixes as open triangles (shown at/below 20 NM)

layer_flight_plan.label: Layer: flight plan
layer_flight_plan.help: active route: past/active/future legs, waypoint symbols, direct-to and the suspended-at-MAP extended final course (FP6; no database, reads the FIX flight-plan bus)

layer_traffic.label: Layer: traffic
layer_traffic.help: ADS-B traffic from the FIX TFC block: relative altitude (needs PALT), trend arrow, alerted targets flash yellow, degraded targets drawn open, stale ones grey; TFC FAIL when a working receiver stops (no database)

terrain_mode.label: Terrain mode
terrain_mode.help: relief = sectional-style hypsometric; caution = the same relief with the SVS hazard bands over it: amber and red by clearance below ownship, magenta above

terrain_palette.label: Terrain hazard palette
terrain_palette.help: caution-mode band colours; the same schemes as the SVS palette

clearance_green_ft.label: Caution clearance (ft)
clearance_green_ft.help: caution mode: amber below this height over terrain (the SVS default)

clearance_yellow_ft.label: Warning clearance (ft)
clearance_yellow_ft.help: caution mode: red below this height over terrain (the SVS default)

water_db_path.label: Water db path
water_db_path.help: water.sqlite (the SVS water_db_path; on the Pi /data/makerplane-data/water/current/water.sqlite). When set, lakes and coastline from the water pack are rasterized into the terrain image

water_max_vertices.label: Water vertex cap
water_max_vertices.help: per-polygon vertex cap for map water rasterization (higher = more coastline/lake detail per rebuild)

water_raster.label: Water raster path
water_raster.help: numpy = vectorised even-odd scanline fill (MP5, default); qt = legacy per-vertex QPointF/QPolygonF/drawPath path, kept for one release of A/B

water_polygon_max_nm.label: Water polygon cutover (NM)
water_polygon_max_nm.help: above this range the crisp coastline/lake polygon overlay is skipped in favour of the terrain pack's water-mask channel (one gather, MP10c); packs with no mask at the chosen level always draw polygons

map_perf_log.label: Perf: log summary
map_perf_log.help: print a MapPerfStats summary every 2s (frames, paint ms p50/p95/max, per-layer job counts, water counts, settle latency, GUI-thread gap probe) -- mirrors svs_perf_log. Dev/bench diagnostic; off by default

map_perf_overlay.label: Perf: overlay chip
map_perf_overlay.help: draw a small on-screen perf stats chip (dev only)

show_distance.label: Show distance
show_distance.help: distance to the TO waypoint (WPDIS), nm

show_ete.label: Show ETE
show_ete.help: time to the TO waypoint (WPETE), H:MM; '--:--' below 30 kt ground speed

show_phase.label: Show phase
show_phase.help: flight phase / CDI scale annunciation (FPLPHASE): ENR, TERM, LNAV, ... green; LOI yellow

show_procedure.label: Show procedure
show_procedure.help: loaded approach type (FPLAPRTYPE) and AIRAC cycle (FPLDBCYC); the cycle and EXPIRED in amber once it has expired

show_turn.label: Show turn
show_turn.help: TURN L / TURN R while the engine flies the coded turn that opens a DF leg (FPLTURN)

hmi_group.label: HMI group
hmi_group.help: hmi_group of the flight_plan instrument a tap opens; blank = every flight_plan instrument

tap_screen.label: Tap screen
tap_screen.help: screen to show before opening the FPL page on a tap (the screen holding the flight_plan instrument); blank = stay on this screen

active_color.label: Active waypoint colour
active_color.help: colour of the TO waypoint ident (WPNAME)

text_color.label: Text colour
text_color.help: colour of the FROM/NEXT idents, separators and data

dbkey.label: FIX key
dbkey.help: FIX-database key whose value is displayed

decimal_places.label: Decimal places
decimal_places.help: digits after the decimal point in the readout

font_mask.label: Font mask
font_mask.help: widest string the readout reserves space for (sizing)

show_units.label: Show units
show_units.help: append the FIX key's engineering units to the readout

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

encoder_set_key.label: Knob writes key
encoder_set_key.help: FIX key the knob writes; blank = the key this gauge displays

encoder_coarse_multiplier.label: Outer ring step factor
encoder_coarse_multiplier.help: the outer ring steps the value by knob step x this

encoder_set_real_time.label: Write while turning
encoder_set_real_time.help: send each step to the FIX key as the knob turns; a timeout before push still reverts it. Ignored with a digit mask

touch_edit.label: Touch to edit
touch_edit.help: touch the gauge to give it the knob; it then marks focus with a ring and edit icon

encoder_num_mask.label: Digit mask
encoder_num_mask.help: set the value one digit at a time, e.g. 000.000 for a radio frequency; push moves to the next digit. Blank = step the whole value

encoder_num_mask_blank_character.label: Digit mask blank
encoder_num_mask_blank_character.help: character drawn for the digits not yet set

encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.label: Digits follow knob step
encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.help: digit entry offers only digits that give a multiple of the knob step within the key's range

encoder_num_require_confirm.label: Confirm after last digit
encoder_num_require_confirm.help: after the last digit the value flashes and one more push saves it

encoder_num_8khz_channels.label: 8.33 kHz channels
encoder_num_8khz_channels.help: digit entry shows 8.33 kHz channel numbers; use with a knob step of 0.008333333333

encoder_num_blink_time_on.label: Digit blink on (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_on.help: how long the digit being set shows in each blink

encoder_num_blink_time_off.label: Digit blink off (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_off.help: how long the digit being set is hidden in each blink

alignment.label: Alignment
alignment.help: horizontal text alignment within the widget

font_mask.label: Font mask
font_mask.help: widest string the text reserves space for (sizing)

default_tab.label: Default tab
default_tab.help: tab index shown on screen load/power-up -- always this fixed tab, never the last one selected (v1, see pyEfis#131 open question 2)

tab_position.label: Tab bar edge
tab_position.help: which edge of the container the tab bar sits on; left/right also rotate the tab labels

fg_color.label: Tab bar foreground
fg_color.help: tab label colour; unset inherits the screen's legible default

bg_color.label: Tab bar background
bg_color.help: tab bar fill colour; unset inherits the screen's legible default

containers.name: tabs
containers.label: Tabs
containers.help: ordered list of {label, layout, instruments} tab pages; each tab is built as its own nested screen (same layout+instruments shape as a top-level screen) laid out against this container's own box, not the screen's

dbkey.label: FIX key
dbkey.help: FIX-database key whose value is displayed

font_mask.label: Font mask
font_mask.help: widest string the text reserves space for (sizing)

number_format.label: Number format
number_format.help: Digit mask: blank = as-is; 000 = 089 (rounded, zero-padded); 000.0 = 089.0 (with decimals)

prefix_text.label: Prefix text
prefix_text.help: static label drawn before the value (e.g. HDG, CRS)

prefix_font_family.label: Prefix font
prefix_font_family.help: font family for the prefix label

prefix_font_percent.label: Prefix font size (%)
prefix_font_percent.help: prefix height as a percent of the widget height

value_color.label: Value colour
value_color.help: colour of the data value (good/normal state)

border_width.label: Border width (px)
border_width.help: box border thickness in pixels; 0 = no border

dbkey.label: FIX key
dbkey.help: FIX-database key whose value this gauge displays

name.label: Name
name.help: label drawn on the gauge (e.g. OIL P, CHT)

decimal_places.label: Decimal places
decimal_places.help: digits after the decimal point in the readout

show_units.label: Show units
show_units.help: append the FIX key's engineering units to the readout

segments.label: Segments
segments.help: 0 = solid bar; >0 draws a segmented (LED-style) bar

tank.label: Tank
tank.help: Bind to a tank from the aircraft page

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

encoder_set_key.label: Knob writes key
encoder_set_key.help: FIX key the knob writes; blank = the key this gauge displays

encoder_coarse_multiplier.label: Outer ring step factor
encoder_coarse_multiplier.help: the outer ring steps the value by knob step x this

encoder_set_real_time.label: Write while turning
encoder_set_real_time.help: send each step to the FIX key as the knob turns; a timeout before push still reverts it. Ignored with a digit mask

touch_edit.label: Touch to edit
touch_edit.help: touch the gauge to give it the knob; it then marks focus with a ring and edit icon

encoder_num_mask.label: Digit mask
encoder_num_mask.help: set the value one digit at a time, e.g. 000.000 for a radio frequency; push moves to the next digit. Blank = step the whole value

encoder_num_mask_blank_character.label: Digit mask blank
encoder_num_mask_blank_character.help: character drawn for the digits not yet set

encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.label: Digits follow knob step
encoder_num_enforce_multiplier.help: digit entry offers only digits that give a multiple of the knob step within the key's range

encoder_num_require_confirm.label: Confirm after last digit
encoder_num_require_confirm.help: after the last digit the value flashes and one more push saves it

encoder_num_8khz_channels.label: 8.33 kHz channels
encoder_num_8khz_channels.help: digit entry shows 8.33 kHz channel numbers; use with a knob step of 0.008333333333

encoder_num_blink_time_on.label: Digit blink on (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_on.help: how long the digit being set shows in each blink

encoder_num_blink_time_off.label: Digit blink off (ms)
encoder_num_blink_time_off.help: how long the digit being set is hidden in each blink

aircraft_symbol.label: Aircraft symbol
aircraft_symbol.help: classic split-wing bars + dot; garmin G3X-style two-tone bat wing + horizon barbs; brackets GRT-style L-brackets; none hides the symbol (SVS-as-background) (g1000/gi275 remain accepted in YAML for back-compat)

symbol_color.label: Symbol colour
symbol_color.help: colour of the fixed aircraft reference symbol

symbol_scale.label: Symbol scale
symbol_scale.help: multiplies the reference symbol size -- wingspan and proportions together (1 = standard)

preview_scene.label: Preview scene (editor)
preview_scene.help: which stylised backdrop the editor twin shows (preview only; the device renders real terrain)

minorDiv.label: Minor division (deg)
minorDiv.help: pitch interval between the smallest ladder ticks

majorDiv.label: Major division (deg)
majorDiv.help: pitch interval between the longer ladder ticks

numberedDiv.label: Numbered division (deg)
numberedDiv.help: pitch interval at which ladder lines get a number

visiblePitchAngle.label: Pitch label range (deg)
visiblePitchAngle.help: ladder marks fade out beyond this from current pitch

bankOpacity.label: Bank display opacity
bankOpacity.help: bank scale, roll pointer, standard-rate diamonds and slip/skid ball together (0 = hidden, 1 = solid)

horizonOpacity.label: Horizon line opacity
horizonOpacity.help: the white zero-pitch reference line (0 = hidden, 1 = solid)

tick_autoscale.label: Auto-scale tick widths to font
tick_autoscale.help: off = use the explicit tick-width / bank-size pixels below

minorDivWidth.label: Minor tick width (px)
minorDivWidth.help: length of the minor pitch ticks (auto-scale off)

majorDivWidth.label: Major tick width (px)
majorDivWidth.help: length of the major pitch ticks (auto-scale off)

numberedDivWidth.label: Numbered tick width (px)
numberedDivWidth.help: length of the numbered pitch ticks (auto-scale off)

drawBankMarkers.label: Standard-rate bank markers
drawBankMarkers.help: show the bank-angle tick arc across the top

bankAngleMaximum.label: Max indicated bank (deg)
bankAngleMaximum.help: largest bank angle marked on the bank arc

excessiveBankDeg.label: Excessive-bank caution (deg)
excessiveBankDeg.help: the bank scale and pointer turn amber past this bank; set it above the steepest turn this aircraft is flown in on purpose (60 clears the 45 and 50 deg steep turns)

bankBugTolerance.label: Bank bug tolerance (+/- deg)
bankBugTolerance.help: half-width of the cyan band around the target-bank bug (BANKBUG); the ACS steep turns are flown to +/-5

touch_edit.label: Touch to set bank bug
touch_edit.help: touch the bank scale, then turn the knob to set the target-bank bug (BANKBUG) in 5 deg steps, from off up to 60 or the excessive-bank caution if lower; push or the timeout ends the edit

bankMarkSize.label: Bank tick size (px)
bankMarkSize.help: length of the bank-arc ticks (auto-scale off)

bank_position.label: Bank scale position (%)
bank_position.help: vertical position of the bank-arc centre, percent up from the bottom (50 = centred, the classic look); the whole cluster incl. pointer and slip ball moves with it

bank_radius.label: Bank scale radius (% height)
bank_radius.help: radius of the bank arc as a percent of widget height (33.3 = the classic height/3); an explicit bankAngleRadius px in YAML overrides it

fd_style.label: Flight director style
fd_style.help: single_cue: a magenta command chevron the aircraft symbol flies into; cross_pointer: separate pitch and roll bars; off: no flight director. Drawn only while FDENG is on and FDPITCH/FDROLL are current

pitch_ladder_avoid_bank.label: Ladder stops below bank arc
pitch_ladder_avoid_bank.help: G1000-style declutter: the ladder climbs into the bank arch but stops below the slip/skid ball

horizon_heading_marks.label: Horizon heading marks
horizon_heading_marks.help: tick marks + labels for compass heading along the horizon

horizon_heading_interval.label: Heading tick interval (deg)
horizon_heading_interval.help: degrees of heading between the horizon ticks

horizon_heading_label_interval.label: Heading label interval (deg)
horizon_heading_label_interval.help: degrees of heading between the numeric labels

horizon_heading_tick_length.label: Heading tick length (px)
horizon_heading_tick_length.help: length of the horizon heading ticks (px)

horizon_heading_color.label: Heading mark colour
horizon_heading_color.help: colour of the horizon heading ticks and labels

svs_enabled.label: Synthetic vision enabled
svs_enabled.help: master on/off (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview). Off shows the plain sky/ground attitude view

svs_tile_path.label: Terrain tile path
svs_tile_path.help: SRTM3 HGT tile directory on the device

svs_range_nm.label: Range (NM)
svs_range_nm.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_auto_range.label: Auto range by altitude
svs_auto_range.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_min_range_nm.label: Min auto range (NM)
svs_min_range_nm.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_palette.label: Terrain palette
svs_palette.help: clearance-band colour scheme (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_terrain_shading.label: Terrain shading
svs_terrain_shading.help: relief = the moving map's elevation colours, with amber, red and magenta only where clearance is low; clearance = every patch coloured by its clearance (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_clearance_green_ft.label: Safe clearance (ft)
svs_clearance_green_ft.help: amber below this height over terrain (green at/above it under clearance shading)

svs_terrain_grid.label: Terrain grid
svs_terrain_grid.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_terrain_texture.label: Terrain texture
svs_terrain_texture.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_safe_gradient.label: Safe-band gradient
svs_safe_gradient.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_earth_curvature.label: Earth curvature
svs_earth_curvature.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_haze.label: Distance haze
svs_haze.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_haze_distance_nm.label: Haze distance (NM)
svs_haze_distance_nm.help: (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_dof_db_path.label: Obstacle DB path
svs_dof_db_path.help: FAA DOF database on the device (optional)

svs_road_color.label: Road colour
svs_road_color.help: ribbon fill colour (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_casing_color.label: Road casing colour
svs_road_casing_color.help: darker outline drawn under the fill (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_casing_m.label: Road casing width (m)
svs_road_casing_m.help: casing half-width add-on over the class width (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_min_px.label: Road minimum width (px)
svs_road_min_px.help: screen-space floor so distant ribbons never drop below this many pixels wide (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_subdivide_m.label: Road subdivide length (m)
svs_road_subdivide_m.help: segments longer than this, within subdivide range, are split so the ribbon follows rolling terrain (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_subdivide_nm.label: Road subdivide range (NM)
svs_road_subdivide_nm.help: subdivision only applies this close to the aircraft (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_lift_ft.label: Road lift (ft)
svs_road_lift_ft.help: height above sampled terrain the ribbon is drawn at (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_road_max_vertices.label: Road vertex cap
svs_road_max_vertices.help: hard cap on extruded vertices per array (casing/fill each); over the cap, far-tier ramps are dropped first, then far-tier trunks (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_papi.label: PAPI lights
svs_papi.help: draw the installed PAPI at its published glide path angle and side, from the NASR airports pack (only where one is installed) (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_traffic.label: Traffic
svs_traffic.help: draw ADS-B traffic from the TFC block in the scene, with the moving map's symbols, relative-altitude tag and climb/descent arrow; never hidden by terrain (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_traffic_range_nm.label: Traffic range (NM)
svs_traffic_range_nm.help: targets farther than this are left to the map (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

svs_perf_log.label: Perf: log summary
svs_perf_log.help: print an SVS per-frame profiler summary every 2s (collector/draw timings) to the log -- mirrors map_perf_log. Dev/bench diagnostic; off by default (rendered on the device; not shown in the editor preview)

encoder_order.label: Knob order
encoder_order.help: place on the screen's knob walk: turning the knob visits instruments in ascending order, and push gives the highlighted one the knob; blank = not on the walk

vs_bug.label: VSSEL bug
vs_bug.help: the VSSEL bug on the scale while the autopilot reports VS active

ini.help: path (under the config dir) to weston.ini

command.help: program to launch inside the compositor

actions.label: Change value (wrap)

actions.help: switch the EGT gauge display mode

actions.label: Checklist: previous item

actions.label: Checklist: toggle item
actions.help: acknowledge / un-acknowledge the current checklist item

actions.help: switch the flight_plan instrument's page ('fpl', 'dto', 'catalog', 'proc' or 'charts')

actions.help: blank opens the Direct To page; an ident stages and activates direct-to that waypoint immediately

actions.help: select an item in the active menu
